meta.title: Sincere Heart - 1
meta.description: I am not true to myself because I am a Sanctifier, but I am a Sanctifier because I am true to myself.

units.rawText: ...I didn't think you would wake up, Big Sis.
units.displayText: ...I didn't think you would wake up, Big Sis.

spans.text: ...I didn't think you would wake up, Big Sis.

units.rawText: But why? You should be the only one who can understand me...
units.displayText: But why? You should be the only one who can understand me...

spans.text: But why? You should be the only one who can understand me...

units.rawText: Her neural cloud assailed by suspicion and anger, Eucharist's face distorts as her emotions heighten.
units.displayText: Her neural cloud assailed by suspicion and anger, Eucharist's face distorts as her emotions heighten.

spans.text: Her neural cloud assailed by suspicion and anger, Eucharist's face distorts as her emotions heighten.

units.rawText: <color=red>After experiencing the same despair, you should have fallen like me!</color>
units.displayText: After experiencing the same despair, you should have fallen like me!

spans.text: After experiencing the same despair, you should have fallen like me!

units.rawText: Enough, Eucharist. The games end here.
units.displayText: Enough, Eucharist. The games end here.

spans.text: Enough, Eucharist. The games end here.

units.rawText: I simply... made a different choice, with the help of some people.
units.displayText: I simply... made a different choice, with the help of some people.

spans.text: I simply... made a different choice, with the help of some people.

units.rawText: A different choice?
units.displayText: A different choice?

spans.text: A different choice?

units.rawText: What a joke. There are no decisions to be made in those experiences.
units.displayText: What a joke. There are no decisions to be made in those experiences.

spans.text: What a joke. There are no decisions to be made in those experiences.

units.rawText: ...Like you, I once doubted the existence of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: ...Like you, I once doubted the existence of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: ...Like you, I once doubted the existence of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Angelus reaches out, taking a shattered piece of the tower's walls into her hand, a result of the battle moments ago.
units.displayText: Angelus reaches out, taking a shattered piece of the tower's walls into her hand, a result of the battle moments ago.

spans.text: Angelus reaches out, taking a shattered piece of the tower's walls into her hand, a result of the battle moments ago.

units.rawText: Stained by smoke and smog, the Sanctifier symbol upon it is still clear as day.
units.displayText: Stained by smoke and smog, the Sanctifier symbol upon it is still clear as day.

spans.text: Stained by smoke and smog, the Sanctifier symbol upon it is still clear as day.

units.rawText: Supposed ideals like justice and duty are just falsehoods written into programs.
units.displayText: Supposed ideals like justice and duty are just falsehoods written into programs.

spans.text: Supposed ideals like justice and duty are just falsehoods written into programs.

units.rawText: The fear you feel upon the battlefield can crush each and every fanciful ideal, dragging us back to reality as we dream.
units.displayText: The fear you feel upon the battlefield can crush each and every fanciful ideal, dragging us back to reality as we dream.

spans.text: The fear you feel upon the battlefield can crush each and every fanciful ideal, dragging us back to reality as we dream.

units.rawText: ...Much like you, I struggled to move forward after witnessing the terror of the battlefield for the first time.
units.displayText: ...Much like you, I struggled to move forward after witnessing the terror of the battlefield for the first time.

spans.text: ...Much like you, I struggled to move forward after witnessing the terror of the battlefield for the first time.

units.rawText: Watching companions by your side fall one by one, fearing that the shadow of death shall visit you next.
units.displayText: Watching companions by your side fall one by one, fearing that the shadow of death shall visit you next.

spans.text: Watching companions by your side fall one by one, fearing that the shadow of death shall visit you next.

units.rawText: Ideals, protecting others, all fancy words for the purpose of decorating death. They have no purpose other than that.
units.displayText: Ideals, protecting others, all fancy words for the purpose of decorating death. They have no purpose other than that.

spans.text: Ideals, protecting others, all fancy words for the purpose of decorating death. They have no purpose other than that.

units.rawText: Operands circle around Eucharist as she seethes.
units.displayText: Operands circle around Eucharist as she seethes.

spans.text: Operands circle around Eucharist as she seethes.

units.rawText: ...It's not a good habit to lie, you know.
units.displayText: ...It's not a good habit to lie, you know.

spans.text: ...It's not a good habit to lie, you know.

units.rawText: If that truly is what you think, Big Sis Angelus, you should be standing by my side.
units.displayText: If that truly is what you think, Big Sis Angelus, you should be standing by my side.

spans.text: If that truly is what you think, Big Sis Angelus, you should be standing by my side.

units.rawText: I'm not lying to you. Even after coming to know of the truth, I still want to live on as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: I'm not lying to you. Even after coming to know of the truth, I still want to live on as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: I'm not lying to you. Even after coming to know of the truth, I still want to live on as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Even if that justice is nothing but a falsehood, I choose to protect it.
units.displayText: Even if that justice is nothing but a falsehood, I choose to protect it.

spans.text: Even if that justice is nothing but a falsehood, I choose to protect it.

units.rawText: <color=orange>What was pain to you is the proof of the path I walked as a Sanctifier.</color>
units.displayText: What was pain to you is the proof of the path I walked as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: What was pain to you is the proof of the path I walked as a Sanctifier.
